question: Who audits the consolidated financial statements of the Government of Canada?
generated_answer:

Who audits the consolidated financial statements of the Government of Canada? The Office of the Auditor General of Canada (OAG) audits the consolidated financial statements of the Government of Canada. You can find the consolidated financial statements in the Public Accounts of Canada, which are published every fall. The OAG has the mandate to audit the government’s financial transactions and financial statements, as well as the transactions and financial statements of certain parent Crown corporations, as defined in the Financial Administration Act.
